KVS NVS TIER 3 INTERVIEW REVIEW 

Interview Process Explained
Post: TGT Maths 
Date: 03/10/26
Place: PM Shree KV Picket, Secunderabad.

1. Entry started at 12:30 pm. I entered at 12:30 pm sharp.
2. After entry, if you have bag or anything else, submit it before entering the building.
3. Wooden board is there on left at the entry of the academic block. 
4. List is there, on which Registration numbers are written with Board number, DV Room no, Interview Room no.
👉🏼Note it down somewhere.
5. After you enter inside the building, your name will be checked in list( Two teachers are checking it). Once, it's is there. You are told to visit Physics Lab for Biometric.
6. After successfull Biometric, you are told to visit your room no. (First floor or 2nd floor or ground floor).
7. You reach to your DV room, there are benches you sit there wherever you want. You will be given two forms one is UNDERTAKING and other is NO CONVICTION. Fill it before they call you for DV.
8. Three teachers are there. Two are checking physical documents. Third is verifying Category certificate and other certificates online on PC.
9. Once, everything is done. They prepare a Pink Coloured file containing your documents zerox. They pass these files to Interview Panel/Room.
10. One side DV keep going one and other side Candidates are called for interview one by one.
11. I got a chance at 5th number. 1st candidate took around 20 minutes. 2nd took around 15 minutes, 3rd took around 10 minutes, 4th ~ 10 minutes,  5th(Me) ~ 10 minutes and so on.
12. After the interview, candidates were called to DV Room for hardly one may be regarding documents to ensure everything is fine.
13. Then, we can leave from there. Outside on the ground, we are offered biscuit and Chai ( absolutely free )
14. After that, we move to exit.
15. The end.
Interview Experience
1. I entered the room, said Good morning, sir, mam...etc.
2. I was a bit nervous( but I managed anyway).
3. Four panel members are there( In my case, 3 male T and 1 female T).
4. My Board no. is 13.
5. I was about to sit, and the lady teacher asked to sign on the list of candidates sheet. I signed and told immediately to go on board and give your demo for 5 minutes. No topic asked, No introduction, nothing at all.
6. I started teaching directly...Hello students..............
7. No need to put a date and   topic name all these felt wastage of time. As we prepared, the picture was completely different over there.
8. I started teaching: *Area of Sector.* I was teaching for 2 minutes, one of the members stopped me and asked (1) what is the perimeter of circle? I said 2pir (2) What is the area of circle? I said pir². (3) He said, Draw a diameter; I drawn. He then said, make a triangle using this. I made it. Then he asked what is that angle made? I said 90°. They said how? Then I said there is a property, angle subtended by arc at centre is double the angle subtended at remaining part.( I fumbled a little). Then explained this 180 then this half of it thus 90°, that lady teacher said didn't understand or Kaise ? Then I explained again.
9. Then, I was called on chair. One male teacher asked me take a page and frame one competency based Question based on what you taught. There I made a mistake. I framed a question but it was an application based on that property, but not connected to real life. He said, he is direct application not competency based. He then said Ok.
10. They, finally concluded and said Thank you. I greeted everyone saying Thankyou and left.
11. I felt nervous during the whole process. I don't know how they took  this.
12. It hardly took 10 minutes to complete.
Review:
1. No Introduction, No questions based on Biodata, No NEP related, No KVS/NVS questions, No pedagogy. Only maths questions, related to the topic I chose only 10th level. We prepared so much related to pedagogy, nep etc but everything went opposite.
2. I felt, they are doing very quickly everything like Kahin train chhoot rahi hai.
3. It was *Average experience* from my side. Not good not bad.

🔸️ At the time of independence, India comprised two categories of political units, namely, the British provinces (under the direct rule of British government) and the princely states (under the rule of native princes but subject to the paramountcy of the British Crown). 

🔸️ The Indian Independence Act (1947) created two independent and separate dominions of India and Pakistan and gave three options to the princely states which are :-

• joining India, joining Pakistan or remaining independent. 

🔸️ Of the 552 princely states situated within the geographical boundaries of India, 549 joined India and the remaining 3 (Hyderabad, Junagarh and Kashmir) refused to join India.

🔸️ However, in course of time, they were also integrated with India–Hyderabad by means of police action, Junagarh by means of referendum and Kashmir by the Instrument of Accession.

first they asked me about aapke up se yha ke environment mai kuch difference dikha? 

Q1 what you know about chatgpt 

Q2 what is critical thinking 

Q3 how fact and figure reliable from different sources 

Q4 they asked me lots of questions from my b.ed bcz i had very high score in it  like singmund frued theory, motivational theory, leadership theory, moral development and their stages

📌 J.V.P COMMITTEE.

#Unionanditsterritories

🔸️ Dhar commission report created much resentment and led to the appointment of another Linguistic Provinces Committee by the Congress in December, 1948, itself to examine the whole question afresh. 

🔸️ It consisted of Jawaharlal Nehru, Vallahbhai Patel and Pattabhi Sitaramayya and hence, was popularly known as JVP Committee.

🔸️ It submitted its report in April, 1949, and formally rejected language as the basis for reorganisation of states.

🔸️ However, in October, 1953, the Government of India was forced to create the first linguistic state, known as Andhra state, by separating the Telugu speaking areas from the Madras state. 

🔸️ This followed a prolonged popular agitation and the death of Potti  Sriramulu, a Congress person of standing, after a 56-day hunger strike for the cause.

प्रमुख संविधान संशोधन:

०प्रथम संविधान संशोधन(1951)–नौवीं अनुसूची जोड़ी गई।

०7वां संशोधन(1956)–
   ० लोकसभा के सदस्यों की संख्या में वृद्धि।
   ०दो या दो से अधिक राज्यों के लिए एक उच्च न्यायालय प्रावधान।

०31वां संशोधन(1972)–लोकसभा सीटें 525 से बढ़ाकर 545 कर दी गईं।

०36वां संशोधन(1975)–सिक्किम को भारत का पूर्ण राज्य बनाया गया।

०38वां संशोधन(1975)–न्यायिक पुनरीक्षण शक्ति का परिसीमन।

०39वां संशोधन(1975)–राष्ट्रपति, उपराष्ट्रपति , स्पीकर और प्रधानमंत्री के चुनाव को चुनौती नहीं दी जा सकती।

०52वां संशोधन(1985)–दल-बदल विरोधी कानूनों का प्रावधान( नई दसवीं अनुसूची जोड़ी गई)

०58वां संशोधन(1987)–संविधान के प्राधिकृत हिन्दी पाठ को प्रकाशित करने हेतु।

०61वां संशोधन(1989)– मतदान की आयु 21 से घटाकर 18 वर्ष कर दी गई।

०69वां संशोधन(1991)–दिल्ली को 'राष्ट्रीय राजधानी क्षेत्र दिल्ली' का विशेष दर्जा दिया गया। 

०70वां संशोधन(1992)–राष्ट्रपति चुनाव के लिए पांडिचेरी और दिल्ली विधायिका के सदस्यों को निर्वाचक मंडल में शामिल करने का प्रावधान ।

०73वां संशोधन(1992)–पंचायती राज संस्थाओं को संवैधानिक दर्जा दिया गया।

०74वां संशोधन(1992)–शहरी स्थानीय निकायों को संवैधानिक दर्जा दिया गया।

०86वाँ संशोधन(2002)–प्रारंभिक शिक्षा को मौलिक अधिकार बनाया गया।

०89वाँ संशोधन(2003)–अनुच्छेद 338-A के तहत राष्ट्रीय अनुसूचित जनजाति आयोग का गठन।

०91वाँ संशोधन(2003)–मंत्रिपरिषद में प्रधान मंत्री सहित मंत्रियों की कुल संख्या लोकसभा की कुल संख्या के 15% से अधिक नहीं होगी।

०97वाँ संशोधन(2011)–सहकारी समितियों का गठन।

०100वां संशोधन(2015)–भारत और बांग्लादेश के बीच भूमि सीमा समझौता।

०101वां संशोधन(2016)–जीएसटी।

०102वां संशोधन(2018)–राष्ट्रीय पिछड़ा वर्ग आयोग को संवैधानिक दर्जा प्रदान किया गया।

०103वां संशोधन(2019)–EWS को 10% आरक्षण।

०104वां संशोधन(2020)
  ०लोकसभा और राज्य विधानसभाओं में एससी और एसटी के लिए सीटों की समाप्ति की समय सीमा सत्तर साल से बढ़ाकर अस्सी साल कर दी गई।
  ० लोकसभा और राज्य विधानसभाओं में एंग्लो-इंडियन समुदाय के लिए आरक्षित सीटें हटा दी गईं।

०105वां संशोधन(2021)–सामाजिक और शैक्षिक रूप से पिछड़े वर्गों (एसईबीसी) की सूची तैयार करने की राज्य सरकारों की शक्ति बहाल की गई।

०106वां संशोधन अधिनियम(2023)–महिला आरक्षण से सम्बन्धित है।

#Prelims Facts
